worked_solution:
First, we express our triple integral as a repeated integral:

$$
{∭}_{R}5x-3y\,\text{d}V={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{-1}^{0}{\int }_{0}^{2}5x-3y\,dy\,dz\,dx
$$

Since we're integrating first with respect to $y,$ then $z,$ and then $x,$ we write $\text{d}V=\text{d}y\,\text{d}z\,\text{d}x.$

First, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to $y,$ treating $x$ and $z$ as constants: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{-1}^{0}{\int }_{0}^{2}5x-3y\,dy\,dz\,dx & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{-1}^{0}[{\int }_{0}^{2}5x-3y\,dy]dz\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{-1}^{0}{[5xy-\frac{3}{2}{y}^{2}]}_{y=0}^{y=2}\,dz\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{-1}^{0}5x(2-0)-\frac{3}{2}(4-0)\,dz\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{-1}^{0}10x-6\,dz\,dx\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to $z,$ treating $x$ as a constant: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{-1}^{0}10x-6\,dz\,dx & ={\int }_{0}^{1}[{\int }_{-1}^{0}10x-6\,dz]dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}[(10x-6)z]_{z=-1}^{z=0}\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}(10x-6)(0-(-1))\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}10x-6\,dx\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we integrate with respect to $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}10x-6\,dx & =[5{x}^{2}-6x]_{x=0}^{x=1} \\  & =5(1-0)-6(1-0) \\  & =-1\end{aligned}
$$
